When the firefighters arrived, they rescued the mother of the owner, but the father, wife and a pair of sons and daughters lost their lives in the fire cave. At 10:36 p.m. on the 3rd, the Yilan County Fire Department received a call from the public on 119, indicating that a residential fire broke out in a 3-storey building opposite Yanshan Township Wenquan Road, Yanshan Central. Thick smoke broke out on the scene and people were trapped, requesting rescue.
